Perfect alignment on MEG cross-frequency coupling analysis (C121-C129). Both evaluations support OCA's utility for phase-amplitude coupling. Peer reviewers found the empirical evidence solid and raised no concerns.

Perfect alignment on comparison to ICA and variants (C154-C165). Both evaluations support the positioning of OCA relative to existing methods. Peer reviewers implicitly accepted these comparisons through their endorsement of the overall approach.
Perfect alignment on forward vs. backward modeling distinction (C169-C177). Both evaluations support this methodological advantage. Peer reviewers did not challenge this technical distinction.
Perfect alignment on comparison to empirical mode decomposition (C178-C183). Both evaluations support the comparison. Peer reviewers accepted this contextual discussion without challenge.

Strong alignment on limitations of existing methods (C3-C5, C15-C25 overlap). Both evaluations support these motivational claims. Peer reviewers' acceptance of OCA's advantages implicitly validates the characterization of existing methods' limitations.
